items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I heard a guitar -- Johnny Johnson, a guitar play -- sing 'Harlem Butterfly' on an early

ctx.x: Right. Well, 'Restless' is a very old song. I had heard it long before I recorded it. And I don't think I ever heard Helen Ward's recording of it. And 'Closest Pages In A Book' -- that's another oldie -- I like to select material, although it's old, it fits in today. You may or may not call them standards, but I think they're good tunes, and they are a little unusual. They're not the usual AABA, as you would say. And they just happen to be songs that stuck in my memory. 'Harlem Butterfly', I had been doing as far…
